title: Vehicle mode does not stop after bluetooth is disconnected, causing 'speak readings' to continue.
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/discussions/3217
Originally posted by **Gferrar123** November 30, 2023 Vehicle mode does not stop after bluetooth is disconnected, causing 'speak readings' to continue. Running Version 2023.11.14 Samsung Galaxy 23 with Android 14 Dexcom G6 I have recreated it with two different bluetooth pairings and the issue has been confirmed by @Navid200 Any fix would be great, but I would love to see a vehicle mode trigger based on Android Auto running, rather than a specific bluetooth connection.

comments.body:
The same here with the latest Samsung System update that installed One UI 6.0 and Android 14 on a Samsung Galaxy S21 FE 5G
Running version 2023.07.16

Please note that you can disable the ongoing speak readings, after leaving the car, by disabling "Vehicle mode" under xDrip+ Motion tracking.

This is not a solution to the problem.  But, it is a way to disable the behavior until this is addressed.

Yes, I know and have done that, what indicated me more clear that this was the reason. But I was thinking that adding extra input could help adressing the problem.
BTW, after the update of samsung, the phone said that xDrip was developped for an older version of the system and possible could cause problems. I not noticed problems at that time, but when first time driving with car the problems started. Until now it is the only issue that I had with the update.

Would be nice when problem solved, but also now xDrip stay the game changer in treathing my diabetes very well! Thanks to xDrip I can have values more then 90% in range and so getting an Hemoglobine A1C of 5.1%, so I'm very happy with this app.

I've been using Vehicle mode happily for years, today I got Android 14 update on my OnePlus Nord 2 5G and it no longer exits the Vehicle mode. In the morning I still had "Vehicle mode: Enabled" followed with "Vehicle mode: Disabled" prints in the log, but now after the update I only see "Vehicle mode: Enabled" prints one after one, every time I enter the car. xDrip no longer detects the exits.
Please try the xDrip release of May 12, 2024 or any after that and if the problem persists, please report it here.
Thanks for the fix! Have been running it for couple of days now and it works just like it used to work before.

> Please try the **xDrip release of May 12, 2024** or any after that and if the problem persists...

Thanx much! This version fixed the problem for me!
(Running Samsung S22 Ultra, Android 14, latest updates)
There is a report on facebook that this is still happening for Android 13.
I still have this issue. Running Android 15 (Pixel 8) and Xdrip 2124091707
